description_zh: 通过本接口，可以查询webCall通话记录信息
name: CloudQueryWebcallCdr

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, you must create a call center instance in the Cloud Call Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the call. If this parameter is not empty, other parameters are invalid, and only the record with the specified unique ID is queried
parameters.help_zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the request. By default, records of the current month are queried. If the request unique ID does not belong to the current month, you must pass the query parameter StartTime as a pass-through query
parameters.help_zh: 查询请求唯一id对应的记录信息，默认查询当前月，如requestUniqueId不属于当前月，查询时请传递查询参数 查询开始时间(startTime)
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The call result. Metric description of the parameter. Valid values:
20: WebCall, TTS synthesis failed.
21: WebCall, customer did not answer.
22: WebCall, customer answered.
23: WebCall, called.
24: WebCall, both parties answered
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明： 20 webcall, TTS合成失败； 21 webcall, 客户未接 ； 22:webcall, 客户接听； 23: webcall； 已呼叫； 24: webcall, 双方接听；
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The province to which the customer's phone number belongs. If this parameter is empty, all provinces are queried. Example: Sichuan. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city to which the customer's phone number belongs. If this parameter is empty, all cities are queried. Example: Chengdu. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en:
The effective type of the start and end time range for the query. This parameter takes effect when StartTime and EndTime are not empty. Valid values:
1: Call start time.
2: Call end time.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value must be a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. StartTime and EndTime cannot span across months. The default value is the first day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value must be a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. StartTime and EndTime cannot span across months. The default value is the last day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The starting index of the records to return. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of records to return. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed 1000. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The key of the custom user parameter for the query. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify UserFieldValue. Only one field can be queried, and fuzzy match is not supported. The constructed custom field-specific search condition is: {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_fieldkey

parameters.help_en: The value of the custom user parameter for the query. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify UserFieldkey. Only one field can be queried, and fuzzy match is not supported. The constructed custom field-specific search condition is: {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_field_value

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the customer
parameters.help_zh: 客户号码
parameters.name: customer_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the agent
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The outbound call group to which the agent belongs. A single outbound call group ID must be 2 to 20 characters in length. You can query one or more agent IDs. Separate multiple agent IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 agent IDs at a time. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属外呼组 单个外呼组号2-20位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持10个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: gno

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the agent
parameters.help_zh: 座席号码
parameters.name: callee_number

parameters.help_en: The actual caller ID number. When the AXB scenario is used for outbound calls, the actual caller ID number is the service instance
parameters.help_zh: 真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，真实外显号码为服务实例
parameters.name: display_number

parameters.help_en: The actual display number for the second party
parameters.help_zh: 第二侧真实外显号码
parameters.name: callee_display_number

parameters.help_en: The caller ID number
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码
parameters.name: clid

parameters.help_en: The caller ID number for the second party
parameters.help_zh: 第二侧外显号码
parameters.name: callee_clid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the total number of records. Valid values:
0: Do not return.
1: Return.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回总条数；取值说明：0: 不返回，1：返回，不传默认为1
parameters.name: return_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the call was answered by a human. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No
parameters.help_zh: 真人接听；取值说明：1-是、0-否
parameters.name: is_real_answer
